snippet.title: RogueHanafuda // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4306590/RogueHanafuda

You are the tenant. The rent keeps rising, and it can only be paid with hanafuda points. Complete combinations, call "Go" (Koi-Koi) and multiply your score. Build the strongest deck in this roguelike deckbuilder and pay up. Fall behind on the rent and you're evicted. Twelve months to survive!

👥 Players: Single-player
🛠️ Developer: WildBerry
📚 Publisher: WildBerry
📅 Release Date: Sep 22, 2026 to Early Access
🎯 Genre: Casual, RPG
